messages:
marie: Heads-up: noticed a spike of reconnect churn on the APAC SSE edge around 03:20 UTC. Looks like keepalive jitter 150-700ms during short stop-the-world pauses. Clients often reconnect twice within 1s.
david: Can you share a short log excerpt and whether these are resumed sessions or fresh ones?
marie: Sample: 
```
2026-03-25T03:20:11Z EDGE pause_ms=420 node=node-apac-3 route=/v1/stream/notifications
2026-03-25T03:20:12Z CLIENT agent=ios/4.0.2 reconnect reason=keepalive_miss resume_token=rt:abc123
2026-03-25T03:20:12Z SERVER new_session=true token=rt:abc123 billed=true
```
paul: Oof. Billing shows a temporary 1.9x cost bump for that route. The runtime is accepting resumes but our metering bills on session start before resume confirms.
marie: Short term: can we add a tiny immediate probe (1-byte ping) from edge after any pause so clients see activity sooner? Also propose increasing runtime resume_grace_ms default to 400ms behind a feature flag.
david: For telemetry, Console currently reports only total reconnects. We should add: burst_reconnect_count (same token reconnects within 2s), median_inter_reconnect_ms, and top client agents. This will let teams detect microbursts.
console-team: We can add a compact dashboard widget: 1m/5m reconnect rate, burst_count, and table of recent tokens with counts. Also add an audit entry whenever someone edits per-route resume_grace_ms.
paul: Billing mitigation: implement a soft dedupe window keyed by resume_token + account, where repeated session starts within 2s are marked dedupable and not billed immediately. If resumed session exceeds 100 tokens produced, invoice normally.
infra-bot: Can implement post-pause probe as a small lightweight write. Plan: canary in apac region only. Watch CPU and egress.
david: Also need a CI integration test that simulates a pause and asserts resumed=true vs new_session. I'll own the runtime test.
marie: Action items:
- infra: canary post-pause probe in APAC (infra-bot)
- runtime: feature-flag resume_grace_ms=400 -> implement + CI test (david)
- console: add burst metrics + widget + edit guardrails (console-team)
- billing: soft dedupe rule (paul)
paul: I'll draft a billing PR with simulation against last week's traces.
console-team: UX note: when exposing per-route resume_grace_ms, show a tooltip describing tradeoffs: higher values reduce reconnect churn but can mask true infra issues. Block edits >2000ms without approval.
marie: Cool. Let's aim for canary this week and a dashboard mock early next week. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
